The '''Corellian/Aqualish war''', also known as the '''Aqualish-Corellian War''', was a minor conflict that occurred in the [[Trans-Nebular sector/Legends|Trans-Nebular sector]] around [[4000 BBY/Legends|four-thousand years]] before the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].

==Background==
Around four millennia before the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]], Corellian colonies were founded in the Trans-Nebular Sector, which was ruled at the time by [[Governor/Legends|Governor]] [[Matri Bey]]. They formed a loose coalition known as the [[Corellian bloc]]. At the same time, a group known as [[Aqualish/Legends|Aqualish]] [[Barralenal]] left their homeworld of [[Ando/Legends|Ando]] and founded colonies in the sector themselves. Both groups were very expansionistic and soon came into conflict.<ref name="GSE" />

==War==
As the two sides engaged in several border skirmishes, Governor Bey tried to stop the growing conflict. However, she was a bureaucrat and not a great politician, so her attempts came too late and proved fruitless. Soon the conflict escalated into an all-out war.<ref name="GSE" />

Other inhabited [[Star system/Legends|systems]] were forced to chose a side in the war or tried to keep a low profile, hoping not be drawn into the fighting. An exception was the planet of [[Goroth Prime/Legends|Goroth Prime]]: Situated at an advantageous position for both sides, the government under [[Rel'Kan]] [[J'Kek D'rith Kalama|J'Kek]] made great profits by selling concessions and mining rights. However as the war dragged on, the [[Gorothite/Legends|Gorothites]] got more greedy. Since neither side could afford an occupation nor losing it to the other side, one side decided to [[Se'Lenti|destroy]] the planet by hurling five asteroids into it.<ref name="GSE" />

During the war, an unit of Aqualish soldiers was secretly positioned on the planet [[Talus/Legends|Talus]], in the [[Corellian system/Legends|Corellian system]]. However, the war ended before they could undertake any military action against the Corellians.<ref name="CDHZ">{{SonyCite|url=players/guides.vm?id=80113|text=CorSec Database H-Z|int=CorSec Database H-Z}}</ref>

The [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]] did not intervene in this conflict, since they were occupied with other conflicts.<ref name="GSE" />

==Aftermath==
The ultimate outcome of the war as well as the war itself were considered by the rest of the [[Galaxy/Legends|galaxy]] as nothing but a minor border skirmish and soon forgotten. The planet of Goroth was considered devastated and void of all life, until its civilization was re-discovered by the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] several thousand years later.<ref name="GSE" />

After the end of the war, the Aqualish war party deployed on Talus was completely forgotten. Their descendants, known as the [[Lost Aqualish]], continued to live on Talus during centuries, in tight isolation from the rest of the galaxy and ready to take the fight against the Corellians when the conflict would begin anew. By the time of the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]], the Lost Aqualishs were still present on Talus, totally unaware of the fall of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Old Republic]] and of the ongoing [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]] between the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] and the Galactic Empire.<ref name="CDHZ" />
